title: Counteraction of perforated cecum lesions in rats: Effects of pentadecapeptide BPC 157, L-NAME and L-arginine

citation.title: Counteraction of perforated cecum lesions in rats: Effects of pentadecapeptide BPC 157, L-NAME and L-arginine

Thus, the essential findings (i.e., cecum perforation syndrome occurring in BPC 157-treated rats shows attenuation and reversal of the consequent tissue damages) indicate the rapidly activated bypassing loops (i.e., through arcade [20,21] vessels or the left ovarian vein and other veins) , corresponding to the prompt reperfusion seen after perforation.
